description: Harden the post-merge path against a diverged local main: durable post-merge-stalled marker + non-destructive git pull --rebase recovery, never an automatic reset --hard.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Confirmed: git rebase (and git pull --rebase) detects clean cherry-picks via patch-id (git log --cherry-mark) and drops commits already present upstream as a preliminary step, unless --reapply-cherry-picks is passed. A local commit whose content was recreated by an upstream squash-merge is therefore dropped non-destructively; genuine un-squashed work is replayed or conflicts (fails loud). Do NOT pass --reapply-cherry-picks (that would re-preserve the subsumed commit).

userStories.title: Add durable post-merge-stalled marker module
userStories.description: As the sidecar, I need a durable .cam-post-merge-stalled.json marker with read/write/remove helpers so that a merged-but-incomplete post-merge is recorded across an orchestrator recycle instead of being silently lost.

userStories.title: Recover post-merge via git pull --rebase, never reset --hard
userStories.description: As the post-merge primitive, I need to pull with --rebase and report completed/remaining steps on failure so that a subsumed local commit is dropped non-destructively and a genuine divergence fails loud instead of wedging the cycle.
acceptanceCriteria: runPostMerge's pull step uses `git pull --rebase origin main` instead of a plain pull (drops a subsumed local commit via patch-id, replays or cleanly conflicts on genuine un-squashed work). [oracle: grep -q "'pull', '--rebase'" src/release/post-merge.ts]

No `git reset --hard` appears anywhere in the post-merge code path (auto-reset is never an action; subsumption is unproven). [oracle: file-assert: `grep -c 'reset.*--hard' src/release/post-merge.ts` returns 0]

On rebase failure the PostMergeOutcome failure variant returns ok:false with reason 'rebase-failed' and carries completedSteps + remainingSteps arrays reflecting where the sequence stopped. [oracle: bun test]

On a clean rebase (including the subsumed-commit case where the rebase drops the local commit and succeeds) the sequence continues through tag, prune, and issue-close in the same run; the early-return only fires on a genuine rebase failure. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Edit src/release/post-merge.ts (pull step at ~line 379; PostMergeOutcome fail variant at ~line 110) + test/release/post-merge.test.ts. Do NOT pass --reapply-cherry-picks (per git docs: that would re-preserve the subsumed commit we want dropped). The clean-rebase continue-path already exists (tag/prune/close run after a successful pull); switching to --rebase is what makes the subsumed-commit case reach it. Extend the fail variant to `{ ok: false; reason: string; completedSteps: string[]; remainingSteps: string[] }` so US-003 can populate the marker; keep every other failure reason (checkout-main-failed, tag-*, version-*) populating these fields too for a consistent shape. Steps vocabulary: checkout, pull-rebase, tag, prune, close. runPostMerge stays a pure git primitive (injectable SpawnFn); it does NOT write the marker itself (no claudeDir here) — the sidecar caller does (US-003).

userStories.title: Write post-merge-stalled marker on merged-but-failed post-merge
userStories.description: As the sidecar merge-watch terminal, I need to persist the post-merge-stalled marker when a merged PR's inner post-merge fails so that the orchestrator learns the cycle half-completed instead of losing every durable marker.
acceptanceCriteria: On a merge-watch terminal whose outcome.kind==='merged' AND outcome.postMerge.ok===false, the sidecar writes .cam-post-merge-stalled.json with prNumber+issueId from the merge-watch state and completedSteps/remainingSteps/reason from the failed PostMergeOutcome. [oracle: bun test]
A merged outcome remains terminal for the merge-watch (the PR really merged); only the durable-marker handling changes, not the merged classification. [oracle: bun test]
The existing ship-stalled merged-branch reconciliation is unchanged, so a merged-but-post-merge-failed cycle is no longer left with zero durable markers. [oracle: bun test]
On a merged outcome whose post-merge succeeded (ok:true) no post-merge-stalled marker is written. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Edit src/commands/sidecar.ts (terminal-outcome branch of makeProductionMergeWatchFn at ~line 748-755, alongside the existing updateShipStalledMarker call). Also needs the US-001 marker module. Add a small helper (e.g. updatePostMergeStalledMarker(markerPath, outcome, state)) next to updateShipStalledMarker, exported for unit tests (anti-shadow-mock: drive the real write against a temp file). Only act when outcome.kind==='merged' && !outcome.postMerge.ok; the non-merged terminals stay owned by updateShipStalledMarker. Do NOT change the merged classification or removeMergeWatchState call. state.issueId may be undefined -> store as null.
